paper.title: Digital Advertising Traffic Operation: Machine Learning for Process Discovery

result.summary: 这篇论文关注 Web 广告流量运营（Web Advertising Traffic Operation）中数字与付费社交广告活动的日常投放、节奏控制与优化管理 [abstract]。作者提出一种基于机器学习技术的流程发现（process discovery）方法，用于自动发现流程变体，并一眼识别问题所在，从而采取纠正措施 [abstract]。论文以 CRM 数据为对象，借助流程挖掘（Process Mining）识别客户服务流程中不期望出现的循环与延迟 [abstract]。原文指出，其动机是解决客户服务流程中不断增多的投诉，必须识别流程本身的弱点并传达给相关部门 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在 Web 广告流量运营中，面对客户服务流程不断增多的投诉，需要识别流程本身的弱点并传达给相关部门 [abstract]。原文指出，借助流程挖掘可以从 CRM 数据中识别流程中不期望出现的循环与延迟 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: In order to solve a growing number of complaints in the customer service process, the weaknesses in the process itself must be identified and communicated to the department.
With the help of Process Mining for the CRM data it is possible to identify unwanted loops and delays in the process.

method.text: 论文提出一种基于机器学习技术的流程发现方法，用于自动发现流程变体，并一眼识别问题所在，进而采取纠正措施 [abstract]。该方法以 CRM 数据为对象，借助流程挖掘来识别流程中不期望出现的循环与延迟 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: With this paper we propose a process discovery based on Machine Learning technique to automatically discover variations and detect at first glance what the problem is, and undertake corrective measures.
With the help of Process Mining for the CRM data it is possible to identify unwanted loops and delays in the process.

findings.text: 原文指出，借助针对 CRM 数据的流程挖掘，可以识别流程中不期望出现的循环与延迟 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: With the help of Process Mining for the CRM data it is possible to identify unwanted loops and delays in the process.
